summary: The school teacher urges the FCC to preserve the E-Rate program to ensure educational opportunity for students, emphasizing the cost and impact of cuts on their programs and safety.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would result in over $500,000 loss to district
claims.evidence_quote: For nearly 30 years, E-Rate has helped ensure that students in low-income urban neighborhoods and rural communities have access to the same tools as students in wealthier districts. While the program has done a stellar job in reaching its intended goals, proposals to sunset the program or restrict it to only certain schools would be catastrophic. Cutting this program would only deepen the inequities that public education is meant to overcome. Students cannot fully participate in modern learning environments without reliable internet access, and schools cannot effectively prepare students for success without it.
